decisions.reason: Premium support reinforces the firm's core differentiator of expert agency support and likely earns recurring revenue, though its absence from the website after 2019 suggests it may have been folded into standard offerings.
The version management tool fits the strategy of reducing recurring operational work for agencies, but its disappearance from the website since 2019 lowers confidence that it meets aspirations.

The contract tool is distant from the hosting core, demand for it was a one-off GDPR effect that has since faded, and it is no longer visible, so problemistic search favors moving its resources to the core hosting platform.
Scalable agency hosting is the flagship line, directly embodies the firm's direction and core competence, and the lack of archived pages reflects missing data rather than poor performance.
